list.title: Replication tasks
list.subtitle: Schedule and monitor file synchronization between remote storage.
list.restoreTooltip: Restore: sync in the reverse direction
list.emptyBody: Click “New task” to schedule your first replication.
list.deleteMessage: The task and its entire run history will be permanently deleted.

form.createSubtitle: Set the source, destination, and how often to synchronize.
form.editSubtitle: Adjust the name, schedule, options, or notifications.
form.pathsLocked: The source and destination paths cannot be changed after creation.
form.taskNameHelp: A clear name so you can recognize this task in the list.
form.name: Name
form.cronHelp: Cron expression (e.g. 0 2 * * * = every day at 02:00). Leave empty to run only manually.
form.cronHelpEdit: Cron expression. Leave empty for manual runs only.
form.rcloneFlagsHelp: Additional flags passed to rclone (optional). Separate them with spaces.
form.taskEnabledHelp: If disabled, the cron schedule is ignored.

retry.preview_one: If the task fails, it will be retried <bold>once</bold>: {{schedule}}
retry.preview_other: If the task fails, it will be retried up to <bold>{{count}} times</bold>: {{schedule}}

notify.label: Notifications
notify.help: Choose a channel to receive alerts. “Skipped” means the task could not start because the previous run was still in progress.

detail.restoreTooltip: Sync in the reverse direction (destination to source)
detail.editTooltip: Edit the name, schedule, or options
detail.emptyBody: Click “Run” to start the first synchronization.
detail.statTransfersTooltip: Files transferred out of the total

tasks.encryptionRequired: A public key is required to enable encryption

list.title: Remote storage
list.subtitle: Configure your file sources and destinations (S3, SFTP, SMB, local folder, and more)
list.colUsedByTooltip: Number of tasks using this storage
list.testConnection: Test the connection to this storage
list.emptyBody: Click “Add” to configure your first remote storage.
list.deleteMessage: This cannot be undone. All configuration data for this storage will be lost.

form.createSubtitle: Configure a new source or destination for your replication tasks.
form.editSubtitle: Change the connection settings for this storage.
form.name: Storage name
form.nameHelp: Unique identifier for this storage. Used in replication tasks.
form.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed after creation.
form.typeHelp: Standard types show a guided form. Advanced types use manual key/value pairs.
form.keepSecretHelp: Stored securely. Leave blank to keep the current value.

generic.help: Enter the key/value pairs that match rclone’s configuration options for this storage type.

oauth.hint: Interactive sign-in — fills the “Token” field automatically.
oauth.needCredentials: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret first, then connect.
oauth.popupBlocked: Could not open the OAuth window. Allow pop-ups for this site.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.help: Required for Minio, Ceph, and other non-AWS providers

pass.label: Password
pass.help: Leave blank if you are using an SSH key

key_file.label: SSH key (path)
key_file.help: Path to the SSH private key file

account.label: Storage account name
account.help: Azure Storage Account name. Leave blank if you are using a SAS URL.

key.label: Account key
key.help: Shared key for the Storage Account. Leave blank if you are using a SAS URL.

sas_url.label: SAS URL
sas_url.help: Account-level or container-level SAS URL. Alternative to the account key.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.help: Leave blank to use the default Azure endpoint.

tenant.label: Tenant ID
tenant.help: Azure AD tenant ID (GUID or domain name, e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com)

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Azure application (App Registration) ID with Sites.ReadWrite.All permission

client_secret.label: Client Secret
client_secret.help: Client secret generated for the Azure App Registration.

drive_id.label: SharePoint site Drive ID
drive_id.help: SharePoint document library ID. Available via Graph Explorer: GET /sites/{site-id}/drives

token.label: OAuth token (JSON)
token.help: Enter Client ID + Client Secret below, then click “Connect with OAuth”, or paste a JSON token from `rclone authorize "drive"`.

service_account_credentials.label: Service account (JSON) — non-interactive alternative
service_account_credentials.help: Alternative to the OAuth token: full JSON of a Google service account. Useful for headless deployments.

scope.label: Access scope
scope.help: Permission requested from the Google Drive API.

options.drive.file: drive.file — only files created by rclone

team_drive.label: Shared Drive ID
team_drive.help: ID of a Shared Drive (formerly Team Drive). Leave blank for a standard My Drive.

root_folder_id.label: Root folder (ID)
root_folder_id.help: ID of the folder used as the root. Visible in the Google Drive URL after /folders/. Leave blank for the drive root.

client_id.label: OAuth Client ID (optional)
client_id.help: Custom OAuth client to avoid rclone’s shared rate limit.

client_secret.label: OAuth Client Secret (optional)
client_secret.help: Required only if you entered a custom Client ID.

token.label: OAuth token (JSON)
token.help: Enter App key + App secret below, then click “Connect with OAuth”, or paste a JSON token from `rclone authorize "dropbox"`.

client_id.label: App key (optional)
client_id.help: Application key of your custom Dropbox app. Leave blank to use rclone’s.

client_secret.label: App secret (optional)
client_secret.help: Required only if you entered a custom App key.

impersonate.label: Impersonate (Dropbox Business)
impersonate.help: Email of the user to impersonate. Only for Dropbox Business with an admin account.

account.label: Application Key ID
account.help: The application key ID (recommended) or the master Account ID.

key.label: Application Key
key.help: The secret value of the B2 application key.

endpoint.label: Custom endpoint
endpoint.help: Leave blank to use the default endpoint.

hard_delete.label: Permanent deletion
hard_delete.help: If enabled, files are deleted instead of being versioned/hidden.

list.title: Notification channels
list.subtitle: Choose where to receive alerts (email, Slack, Mattermost, and more) on failure or success.
list.colUrlTooltip: URL in Apprise format (protocol://...). Defines where alerts are sent.
list.colUsedByTooltip: Number of tasks using this channel
list.emptyBody: Click “Add” to configure your first notification channel.
list.deleteMessage: This cannot be undone. Tasks using it will no longer receive notifications.

form.createSubtitle: Configure a channel to receive alerts by email, Slack, Mattermost, and more.
form.editSubtitle: Change the settings for this notification channel.
form.name: Channel name
form.nameHelp: A clear name so you can recognize this channel in the list.
form.channelEnabledHelp: If disabled, no notifications will be sent through this channel.
form.languageHelp: Language of the messages this channel sends. On create, this defaults to the interface language.
form.messageHelp: Leave the subject and body empty to use the default text in the selected language.
form.subject: Subject
form.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded.

encryption.enableHelp: The server holds only the public key: it can encrypt but cannot decrypt. The private key is asked for only when restoring.
encryption.orPaste: or paste an existing age public key
encryption.keepPrivate: Keep the matching private key safe: without it, the encrypted data is permanently unrecoverable.

restore.title: Restore
restore.willDecrypt: Data from <path>{{location}}</path> will be decrypted and then written to the target below.
restore.willCopy: Data from <path>{{location}}</path> will be written to the target below.
restore.neverStored: never stored, used only for this restore
restore.overwriteWarning: By default, the target is the task’s original source. This operation can overwrite existing files.

keygen.title: Generate a key pair
keygen.publicKey: Public key (will be saved on the task)
keygen.privateKey: Private key (NOT saved — store it now)
keygen.warning: This private key is the <bold>only</bold> way to decrypt your backups. It is <bold>not kept</bold> by the application and will <bold>never be shown again</bold>. Store it in a password manager.
keygen.savedConfirm: I have saved my private key in a safe place
